baseline: Fixed SN1_H1; no SN1 feature, model, score, portfolio, cost, or submission contract changes
train_window: Train signal dates 2011-01-01 through 2016-03-31; 2011-2015 complete, 2016 partial. Use saved SN1_H1 prediction index only for yearly coverage denominators.
confirmation_policy: One fixed Phase 0/1 source and PIT audit. No Valid, Valid target, raw-target, or target values accessed. No candidate fit. Current 2025-2026 relationship membership must never be back-applied. Train history is known development history, not independent OOS.

trials.comparison: Check whether the available major_customer source can establish archived, publication-time PIT edges for the Train period; stop if not.

feature_definitions.audited_relation: Only directed supplier -> major_customer edges; no reverse, undirected, or multi-hop propagation.
feature_definitions.availability: Use first conservative public filing timestamp. Fiscal period end is descriptive only. Date-only public time is conservatively available from the next Japanese trading session.
feature_definitions.pit_requirement: An edge is eligible at signal date t only when its public availability is no later than t and the relation status is not superseded, ended, ambiguous, or unknown.
feature_definitions.current_snapshot_exclusion: JP_Market_Vis 2026 snapshot data may be used for taxonomy/evidence-schema review only; its relationship rows are not applied to 2011-2016.
feature_definitions.unrun_feature: If and only if a future Phase 1 audit passes, one candidate may be proposed under a new experiment ID: equal-weight NCMOM20 = mean over PIT customers of sum of 20 daily customer residual returns dated t-20..t-1. This experiment did not calculate it.

model: None. Phase 0/1 source-feasibility audit only; no diagnostics, fitting, or portfolio evaluation.
selection_rule: Pass Phase 1 only with empirical archived PIT edges, documented first-public timestamps, PIT-consistent supplier/customer mappings, measured Train customer-price coverage, and a defensible non-permanent update/termination rule. Otherwise classify PIT INSUFFICIENT and stop. The audit did not satisfy this gate.
